title: Strong monoidal Hom comparison from an exact dual pair
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category], with internal Homs $H_{\mathcal C},H_{\mathcal D}$ specified by natural adjunction bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(A\otimes T,B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(T,H(A,B))$. Let $G:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a strong monoidal functor [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], with tensorator $\mu_{A,B}:GA\otimes GB\xrightarrow{\sim}G(A\otimes B)$. Let $D,P\in\mathcal C$ have maps $e:P\otimes D\to\mathbf1$ and $c:\mathbf1\to D\otimes P$ satisfying $(e\otimes1_P)(1_P\otimes c)=1_P$ and $(1_D\otimes e)(c\otimes1_D)=1_D$, with associators and unitors understood. For every $N\in\mathcal C$, the specified comparison
$$\gamma_{P,N}:G H_{\mathcal C}(P,N)\longrightarrow H_{\mathcal D}(GP,GN),$$
defined as the transpose of $GP\otimes G H_{\mathcal C}(P,N)\xrightarrow{\mu}G(P\otimes H_{\mathcal C}(P,N))\xrightarrow{G(\operatorname{ev})}GN$, is an isomorphism. No equivalence or exactness assumption on $G$ is required.
